Before You Book a Black Friday Cruise Deal, Try This!

by Gary Bembridge

Before You Book a Black Friday Cruise Deal, Try This

Thinking of taking advantage of Black Friday  cruise deals to  book a cruise? Before you make any decision and book, there is something I suggest you do

Put the cruise  travel agency I recommend to the test, which is the The Cruise Globe Travel Agency. Getting a quote is free, there’s no obligation to book, and they don’t charge a booking fee. And based on what I have been seeing they will find the best Black Friday deal which is often better than booking direct or through others.

Get a free cruise quote from The Cruise Globe

Why I recommend The Cruise Globe Travel Agency

Even after doing 136 cruises, I still use a cruise-specialist travel agent. I know what I like, but I want someone who can check which fares I’m eligible for, what’s included and whether there’s a better cabin or offer for the money.

The Cruise Globe Travel Agency was set up by two cruise-mad friends of mine, Matt Jones and Emma Le Teace, whom you may know as Emma Cruises. I’ve known them for years and seen how they’ve built this agency with cruise expert agents in the USA and UK.

Discover more

Travel planning guide

What’s impressed me most is what I’ve heard from people I’ve sent their way. Most of those who’ve reported back tell me they got a better fare than they’d found by going direct to the cruise line or through another agent. So, give them a chance and see how they do.

How to tell which Black Friday cruise deal is better

You can send the team the ship, sailing date, cabin category, and number of travellers or if you are still deciding which cruise then tell the team where you’d like to go, when you can travel, who’s going and roughly what you want to spend. Mention anything that would make or break the trip for you. That could be a low solo supplement, a balcony cabin or a particular embarkation port. If your dates are flexible, say so and ask them to check nearby sailings too.

My Black Friday challenge is simple. Give The Cruise Globe one cruise to price up and see how their quote compares with what you’d usually book. If you give them a try, let me know how you got on. I’d love to hear.

Get your free, no-obligation quote at TipsForTravellers.com/bookcruise
